title: Modelling Milky Way-like Galaxies
venue: Ongoing Research Work — advised by Prof. Mohit Bhardwaj
summary: Built a data pipeline to ingest and process targeted subsets of a 1 PB high-dimensional galaxy particle dataset, using local caching and axis-wise statistical aggregation to speed up feature engineering. Studying the circumgalactic medium (CGM) and feedback mechanisms in Milky Way-like galaxies through statistical modelling and simulation-driven analysis; a manuscript is in preparation.
